'''Brimhaven''' is a [[Members|members-only]] pirate town located on north-western [[Karamja]], led by the wealthy [[Scarface Pete]]. Although it is mainly inhabited by pirates, it is also the home of [[Sandy's Sand Corp]]oration and contains outposts of two [[Varrock]]ian crime gangs aiming to rob the pirate leader. The street from [[The Shrimp and Parrot]] restaurant to [[Davon's Amulet Store.|Davon's Amulet Store]] is called Palm Street.

==Transportation==
[[File:Palm Street.png|thumb|A view of Palm Street, with the Dead Man's Chest on the right and the [[Black Arm Gang]]'s hideout on the left.]]Several transport options bring players into or close to Brimhaven, listed here with their arrival destination. From closest to farthest:
*{{Plink|Teleport to House}} — Brimhaven [[house portal]]. Requires a POH in Brimhaven.
*{{Plink|Achievement diary cape}} — [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]].
*{{Plink|Spirit trees|pic=Spirit tree (Construction) icon}} — Northern Brimhaven. Requires 83 [[Farming]].
*{{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon|txt=Fairy code}} {{Fairycode|BJR}} — [[Fisher Realm]], which can be exited by blowing the [[magic whistle]], landing near the [[Brimhaven mine]].
*{{plink|Minigame teleport|pic=Minigame icon}} — [[TzHaar Fight Pits]], in the dungeon east of Brimhaven. Usable once every 20 minutes.
*{{Plink|Amulet of glory}} teleports players to [[Musa Point]], east of Brimhaven.
Additionally, many forms of non-teleport transport exist:

* Players can sail to and from [[East Ardougne]] by paying [[Captain Barnaby]] 30 [[coins]] at his ship on the northern Brimhaven docks. Wearing [[Karamja gloves]] will lower the cost to 15 coins, and wearing a [[Ring of Charos(a)]] will allow the player to travel for free.
* [[Hajedy]] will offer players rides in his [[Shilo Village cart system|cart]] to [[Shilo Village (location)|Shilo Village]] for a fee of 200 coins after completion of the [[Shilo Village]] [[quest]].
* Players may also take the Karamja ship in [[Port Sarim]] used for [[Dragon Slayer I]] and [[Pirates Treasure]] for 30 coins, then walk west past the volcano. There are no requirements on the gate.

== History ==
{{LoreSources|Varrock Museum|Kangai Mau|Cap'n Izzy No-Beard|Tiadeche|guide book|Herman's book|the1=yes|dialogue2=yes|dialogue3=yes|dialogue4=yes|the5=yes}}

It is unknown exactly when Brimhaven formed, although the land appears on a map dating back to the Fourth Age. At some point, settlers from the mainland arrived, either displacing the native population or coming to an area which was abandoned by its previous population. While multiple tribes are known to have existed in the greater Karamja area, less evidence exists of who directly lived in the land that would later become Brimhaven when mainland settlers arrived early in the [[Fifth Age]].

A treasure hunter who came to the area later found a massive cave under the surface with traps and platforms leading in all directions. He theorised that an ancient civilisation had made it, although the exact creators are still unknown. After more and more settlers arrived, the village grew in size, and began exporting [[karambwans]] across Gielinor. Regular transport was soon created that linked the city to [[Ardougne]]. At some point, [[Wise Old Man|a wizard from the mainland]] arrived and encouraged the local tribes to charge visitors to enter the [[Brimhaven Dungeon|caves below]].

With expansion came businesses, such as a sand-shipping business, as well as gang activity. Notably, the [[Black Arm Gang]] and the [[Phoenix Gang]] both established bases in the pirate town, maintaining a presence to this day.

=== Docks ===
The docks host a ship to [[Ardougne]], which travels each way and costs 30 coins to ride. The [[charter ship]]s also have a dock, and provide rides to several other locations. After completing [[Cabin Fever]], the charter ship fare is reduced by 50%. Wearing the [[Ring of Charos(a)]] also reduces the fare by 50%. These two bonuses can be stacked to reduce the cost to 25%.

{{Charter ship fares}}

=== Skill training spots ===
Players looking to train Fishing can catch [[karambwanji]] at several spots south of the town. The town also hosts the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]], where players can test their [[Agility]] level and earn tickets for doing so. To the north-west of the area is the [[Brimhaven mine]], featuring 10 [[gold rocks]]. Finally, there are several farming patches, including a [[spirit tree]] [[Farming/Patch locations#Spirit tree patches|patch]] and a [[fruit tree]] [[Farming/Patch locations#Fruit tree patches|patch]], the latter of which is commonly used during [[Farming runs]].

Players looking to train combat can take the swing to nearby [[Moss Giant Island]], a small island with 5 [[moss giants]].

=== Brimhaven Dungeon ===
The [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] is a massive dungeon below Brimhaven, home to dragons ([[Red dragon|red]], [[Bronze dragon|bronze]], [[Iron dragon|iron]] and [[Steel dragon|steel]]) and several other [[monsters]].

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Brimhaven with level 25 [[Sailing]]. The dock to the north of the town offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]

==Inhabitants==
=== Personalities ===
*{{Chatl|Alfonse the waiter}}, an oddly-friendly member of the [[Phoenix Gang]] who also sells food.
*{{Chatl|Bartender (Dead Man's Chest)|txt=Bartender}}, who sells [[grog]] and [[Karamjan rum]].
*{{Chatl|Cap'n Izzy No-Beard}}, the owner of the [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]] and the seller of the [[Agility skillcape]].
*{{Chatl|Captain Barnaby}}, an old sailor who can take players to [[Ardougne]] or [[Rimmington]].
*{{Chatl|Charlie the cook}}, a Phoenix Gang-affiliated chef who owns the [[The Shrimp and Parrot|Shrimp and Parrot]].
*{{Chatl|Cracked Jenny's Tea Cup|pic=Parrot chathead}}, a parrot who sits on Cap'n Izzy's shoulder.
*{{Chatl|Davon}}, an amulet merchant with no storefront or stall. 
*{{Chatl|Garth}}, a gardener who can look after [[fruit trees]].
*{{Chatl|Garv}}, a guard posted outside the mansion of [[Scarface Pete]].
*{{Chatl|Grubor}}, a gang member and man of few words — unless those words are the secret passphrase.
*{{Chatl|Hajedy}}, a cart driver who pulls the cart with his own two hands.
*{{Chatl|Jolly Jim}}, a crewmate who can be hired at 85 [[Sailing]].
*{{Chatl|Kangai Mau}}, a member of the [[Rantuki Tribe|Rantuki]] tribe who wants to recover [[Totem|an artefact stolen from his people]].
*{{Chatl|Lubufu}}, a childless old fisherman wishing to pass on his knowledge.
*{{Chatl|Pirate Jackie the Fruit}}, a [[Achievement Diary|diary taskmaster]] who also runs the [[Agility Arena Store|Agility Arena store]].
*{{Chatl|Port master|pic=Port master (Brimhaven) chathead}}, who helps players with [[port tasks]].
*{{Chatl|Praistan Ebola}}, a gnome who looks after the area's [[spirit tree]].
*{{Chatl|Sandy}}, owner of [[Gielinor]]'s [[Sand pit|sandboxes]] and [[The Hand in the Sand#Sandy Truth-Be-Told|the terrible secret they hold]].
*{{Chatl|Saniboch}}, a tribesman who guards the entrance to the deadly [[Brimhaven Dungeon]].
*{{Chatl|Shipwright Steve}}, a shipwright who helps the player with various [[Sailing]] needs.
*Several {{Chatl|Swarm|pic=Swarm|txt=swarms of bugs}} which follow the [[Player character|player]] around.
*{{Chatl|Tool Leprechaun|txt=Tool leprechaun}}, a green-clad fellow who can store gardening supplies and [[Bank note|note]] produce.
*2 {{chatl|Trader Crewmember|pic=Trader Crewmember (1) chathead|txt=Trader crewmembers}}, ostentatiously-clad crewmembers who ferry players for exorbitant prices. 
*{{Chatl|Trobert}}, a Black Arm Gang member who helps players commit identity theft.
